sections.heading: How ordering works
sections.text: Every piece is made to order. Send a request and I will get back to you within 2–3 days to confirm details, price and delivery time. Payment is made once the order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Returns & refunds
sections.text: Since each piece is made especially for you, made-to-order items cannot be returned. If something is wrong with your piece, contact me within 14 days of delivery and we will sort it out. I do not accept returns if the item is not faulty or not as described.
